crossRefs.note: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?
Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?
But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.
But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and…
(yes, I have not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);
See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

translations.web: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.
translations.bsb: For the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food.
translations.kjv: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.
translations.asv: For the ear trieth words, As the palate tasteth food.
